scope.summary: W4 driver --case resolves after tools/list discovery (generated contract cases selectable) and keeps a requested stdio-only file case selected across the HTTP pass, so one scoped run can select both kinds; unknown ids are still rejected.
out_of_scope: Case content and product behaviour of the selected cases.

entry_points.name: python3 scripts/e2e/w4/driver.py --lane <lane> --case ... (external client, release binary)
entry_points.trace: One scoped invocation per lane at ef2885a5 with 12 --case ids mixing the generated contract case w4_contract_oracle_plsql_lineage_direction_wrong_enum and stdio-only file cases (w4_runtime_issue46_scn_probe_cached, w4_runtime_issue47_killed_session_recovers, w4_runtime_issue47_killed_session_dml_not_replayed): on free23, xe21 and xe18 every requested id was selected and executed (21 rows: 12 stdio + 9 http; the generated case ran on both transports), and no 'unknown scoped W4 case(s)' abort occurred. A deliberately malformed invocation (all ids passed as one argument) was rejected with 'unknown scoped W4 case(s)', so unknown ids still fail closed.
